svg.title: 32 FDA recalls since 2012 included compounded sermorelin
svg.desc: 32 FDA recalls since 2012 included compounded sermorelin. 2012: 1 sterility, 0 other. 2013: 3 sterility, 1 other. 2014: 0 sterility, 0 other. 2015: 6 sterility, 0 other. 2016: 4 sterility, 0 other. 2017: 0 sterility, 1 other. 2018: 2 sterility, 1 other. 2019: 4 sterility, 0 other. 2020: 0 sterility, 0 other. 2021: 1 sterility, 0 other. 2022: 4 sterility, 2 other. 2023: 0 sterility, 0 other. 2024: 0 sterility, 0 other. 2025: 1 sterility, 0 other. 2026: 1 sterility, 0 other.

svg.text: Recall events by year started. Most cite lack of sterility assurance at the pharmacy, not a failed test of sermorelin.

svg.text: 2 were Class I, FDA's most serious category. One recall can cover many products; 19 of 32 included sermorelin blends with other peptides.
